description: Uva Provincial Council - Notifying the Statute for Council Secretariat Staff of  the Provincial Council, No. 03 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of a new statute (Statute for Council Secretariat Staff of the Provincial Council of Uva Province Bearing No. 3 of 2017) that establishes legal frameworks, regulations, and administrative procedures for provincial council staff. It creates new legal provisions, cancels previous statutes, and establishes regulatory requirements for staff recruitment, service conditions, and administrative operations, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
